assets.name: Incinerator
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D tower-defense sprite atlas. Generate one transparent PNG, 1536x768 landscape, exactly two equal square cells side by side. Both layers will be overlaid by the game; never draw the body in the weapon cell. Transparent empty background with real alpha, no checkerboard, no labels, text, borders, shadows or scene. Style: bold clean minimal top-down orthographic geometric sci-fi silhouette, nearly black opaque armor interiors, thin colored neon outlines and a few large readable mechanical details; inspired by simple black octagonal tower bases with colored rims and separate black outlined barrels. NOT isometric, no perspective, no photorealism, no tiny busy detail, no baked glow. Body footprint about 440px diameter centered in left cell, weapon pivot housing about 180px diameter with forward tip exactly 400px above pivot (keep tip inside canvas at y=32, so use 352px forward reach instead). Rear of weapon at most 160px below pivot; entire weapon within its own cell. Outline thickness 15px, flat shading. Make dark mass dominate and color trace structure.
INCINERATOR: burnt-orange and ember-red palette. Body is a squat clipped-corner armored fuel bunker with two protected lateral fuel tanks and a circular black bearing. Weapon is a short broad flamethrower nozzle with flared rectangular muzzle, three heat vents and a small red pilot-light inset at the NORTH tip; a pair of curved fuel pipes flank the breech. No actual flame. Front nozzle center must lie on vertical centerline. Clear, compact industrial silhouette.
